title: Moving
descriptionFa: فعل‌های حرکت بدن، ride و drive، و نرسیدن یا رسیدن به قطار.

words.example: I walk to school because it's very close.
I run in the park every morning.
The children love to jump into the pool.
Everyone started to dance at the wedding.
Can you swim? Yes, but not very well.
We want to climb Damavand next summer.
Be careful on the ice! Don't fall!

words.meaningFa: سوار شدن و راندن (دوچرخه، موتور، اسب)
words.tipFa: دوچرخه، موتور و اسب رو ride می‌کنیم. گذشته: rode.

words.example: My mother is learning to drive.
words.tipFa: ماشین، اتوبوس و قطار رو drive می‌کنیم. گذشته: drove.

words.example: Hurry up or we'll miss the train!
words.tipFa: miss معنی «دلتنگ بودن» هم داره: I miss you.

words.example: If we leave now, we can catch the last bus.
words.tipFa: ضدِ miss. گذشته: caught. یعنی «گرفتن» هم هست: catch a ball.
